hook.text: A single invisible pixel in an email can reveal when you opened it, where you were, and what device you used.

buildup.text: Tracking pixels are tiny 1x1 images embedded in emails and web pages that phone home when loaded.

discovery.text: When the pixel loads, it sends your IP address, location, device type, and timestamp to the sender.

twist.text: Most marketing emails contain tracking pixels. You're being monitored before you even click a link.

climax.text: A single pixel, invisible to the eye, tells marketers exactly when and where you read their message.

punchline.text: One invisible pixel. Your reading habits exposed.

quiz.question: What information can a tracking pixel in an email reveal?
options: When you opened it, your location, and your device type
Only whether the email was delivered
